citation.authors: Kouame AC, Kouassi KN, N'dri YD, Amani NG

cited_by.title: Plantain, yam and cassava: blood sugar and safety

record.population: Healthy adults in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire (numbers not in the abstract)
record.design: Glycaemic index tests to the ISO protocol: 50 g carbohydrate servings against glucose
record.finding: Most of the five staples tested had a high glycaemic index above 70; attieke was lower at 63. Attieke had a high glycaemic load (29), placali and maize stiff porridge a medium one (17 and 16), and pounded cassava-plantain and pounded yam 26 and 22.
record.note: Measured in healthy people, not people with diabetes; numbers of volunteers not in the abstract.
